type.label: wrong JSON type
type.correction: Send the value as the JSON type the schema defines for this field.

json_text.label: text instead of a JSON object
json_text.correction: Send the value as a JSON object or array, not as a string that holds JSON.

unknown_key.label: not a field of this object
unknown_key.correction: Use only field names the schema defines for this object.

never.label: field not accepted here
never.correction: Put this content where the field's schema description places it; this field stays out of the call.

tool_call_notation.label: tool-call notation inside a text value
tool_call_notation.correction: Give each argument its own field; a text value holds only its own content.

unclosed_fence.label: SQL fence not closed
unclosed_fence.correction: Close each SQL fence with a bare line of three backticks after its opening line or its SQL, and keep the paragraphs around it.

missing.label: required field
missing.correction: Add a value for this field as its schema describes.

neighbor_undecided.label: neighbor without a decision
neighbor_undecided.correction: Give each listed neighbor one decision as the schema describes.

slot_unplaced.label: detail slot ids placed in no section
slot_unplaced.correction: Add each listed id to the node_ids of the section that describes it, with its findings in that section's text.

node_unexplained.label: result node ids placed in no section
node_unexplained.correction: Add each listed id to the node_ids of the section that describes it.

not_found.label: not an object in the loaded model
not_found.correction: Name an object of the loaded model by its id.

report_not_found.label: not an object in the loaded model
report_not_found.correction: Name an object of the loaded model by its id.
report_not_found.fallback: If you cannot correct it, write that information in the detail memory instead, highlighted with a callout naming the unresolved issue.

out_of_scope.label: outside the approved scope
out_of_scope.correction: Name an object inside the approved scope; where the field's schema description names a form for an object outside it, use that form.

column_out_of_scope.label: column outside the approved scope
column_out_of_scope.correction: Remove the outside column; if it is the entry's only supplier or its out_node, omit the column_flow entry, never empty upstream_columns. Ask the outside object a follow-up in questions and record the fact in sections.
column_out_of_scope.fallback: If no in-scope supplier can express the fact, write it in sections instead, highlighted with a callout naming the unresolved supplier and columns.

result_out_of_scope.label: outside the approved scope, so not an id of the result
result_out_of_scope.correction: Name only node ids of the result.
result_out_of_scope.fallback: Where the fact concerns an object outside the result, it is still required: state it in the text of the section that describes it as a callout starting with ⚠️ that names the object. Keep every other section unchanged; its node_ids name only ids of the result.

not_neighbor.label: not a neighbor of the current object
not_neighbor.correction: Name a direct neighbor of the current object.

unknown_target_column.label: not a declared column of that object
unknown_target_column.correction: Name a column declared on that object.

unknown_column.label: not a declared column of that object
unknown_column.correction: Name a column declared on that object.
unknown_column.fallback: If you cannot correct it, write that information in the detail memory instead, highlighted with a callout naming the unresolved issue.

closed_neighbor.label: neighbor already pruned or visited
closed_neighbor.correction: Name a neighbor that is still open; a pruned or visited neighbor takes no further decision.

bad_caller_output.label: not an active output of the caller
bad_caller_output.correction: Name an active output of the caller that reads this function.

not_current_object.label: not the current object
not_current_object.correction: Use the id of the current object.

not_in_result.fallback: If you cannot correct it, write that information in the detail memory instead, highlighted with a callout naming the unresolved issue.
not_in_result.label: not in the result graph, which is fixed at this stage
not_in_result.correction: Name a node id of the result graph.

addable_to_result.fallback: If you cannot correct it, write that information in the detail memory instead, highlighted with a callout naming the unresolved issue.
addable_to_result.label: not in the result graph
addable_to_result.correction: Name a node id of the result graph, or bring the real id into view with add_node_ids.

unknown_evidence_id.label: not an evidence id of this step
unknown_evidence_id.correction: Use an evidence id shown on a sql fence line of this step, or write the SQL inside the fence.

uncommitted_label.label: not a committed section label
uncommitted_label.correction: Use a committed section label, or give the new label its own text.

enum.label: not an allowed value
enum.correction: Send one of the values the schema lists for this field.

size.label: outside its size bound
size.correction: Keep the value within the length or count the schema states.

invalid.label: breaks the rule of this field
invalid.correction: Send a value that meets the rule in the field's schema description.

duplicate.label: repeats an earlier entry
duplicate.correction: Keep one entry per key, with the repeated content merged into it.

conflict.label: neighbor has both a question and a prune entry
conflict.correction: Keep its question; prune_neighbors lists only neighbors without a question.

depth_zero.label: both depth sides are 0
depth_zero.correction: Set at least one depth side above 0.

query_too_short.label: query too short to match a name
query_too_short.correction: Send a fragment of an object or column name.

query_not_a_name.label: punctuation only, which matches no name
query_not_a_name.correction: Send part of a name, or set mode to regex for a pattern.

invalid_regex.label: pattern does not compile within the length and time limits
invalid_regex.correction: Send a simpler pattern that compiles, or a plain name fragment.

start_order.label: starts at or before the section above it
start_order.correction: Give each section a start after the start of the section above it.

prune_target.label: this neighbor cannot be pruned here
prune_target.correction: Prune only a neighbor the schema lists as prunable.

prunes_origin.label: would remove the origin from the view
prunes_origin.correction: Keep the origin in the view; prune_node_ids names other nodes.

disconnects_view.label: would leave the view disconnected
disconnects_view.correction: Keep every remaining node connected to the origin through the view.

empty_view.label: leaves no node in the view
empty_view.correction: Keep at least one node in the view.

not_overwritten.label: held value could not be overwritten
not_overwritten.correction: Correct the supplied replacement; the earlier valid value stays held.

identical_resend.label: same call as the one already rejected
identical_resend.correction: Change the listed fields before sending the call again.

duplicate_read.label: read already answered in this step
duplicate_read.correction: Answer from the result already in the conversation, or call a different read.

one_call.label: not evaluated: one commit call per reply
one_call.correction: Send one commit call per reply that carries all its content.

already_started.label: an exploration is already running
already_started.correction: Continue the running exploration with lineage_submit_findings.

no_op_refine.label: refinement changes nothing in the proposal
no_op_refine.correction: Apply the requested change to scope, mode, classification, columns or filter, or answer the user in text when the plan needs no change.

stale_revision.label: not the revision the approval card shows
stale_revision.correction: Copy the revision the approval card shows.

ambiguous_repair.label: several calls need correction and no values are held
ambiguous_repair.correction: Send one complete call with every field.

off_policy.label: tool not offered in this step
off_policy.correction: Call a tool this step offers.

exploration_complete.label: exploration complete
exploration_complete.correction: Call lineage_present_result to assemble the report.

no_session.label: no exploration is running
no_session.correction: Start an exploration with lineage_start_exploration, or answer from what the conversation holds.

no_run_memory.label: no stored run for the applied view
no_run_memory.correction: Answer from what the applied view shows.

no_result_source.label: no preview scope or completed exploration to present
no_result_source.correction: Answer in text from what the conversation holds.

over_budget.label: scope exceeds the discovery budget
over_budget.correction: Propose an exploration with lineage_start_exploration; it reads the scope hop by hop.

result_too_large.label: result larger than this step holds
result_too_large.correction: Send a narrower request: fewer ids, a filter or fewer types.

fresh_proposal.label: additional SQL needs its own approval
fresh_proposal.correction: Send a new proposal with origin and scope.

prune_current_refused.label: the current object cannot be pruned here
prune_current_refused.correction: Record the current object with lineage_submit_findings.

no_tool_call.label: reply carried no call of the required tool
no_tool_call.correction: Call the required tool now, with its content as arguments.

empty_reply.label: reply carried no text and no call
empty_reply.correction: Answer the user in text, or call a tool for more evidence.

awaiting_approval.label: waiting for the user decision on the card
awaiting_approval.correction: Wait for the user decision; the card holds the proposal.

backend_fault.label: extension fault
backend_fault.correction: The run ends; the extension reports the fault to the user.

no_project.label: no project is loaded in the Data Lineage panel
no_project.correction: Ask the user to load a project in the Data Lineage panel.
